english.title: Attempt to place / throw / drop / trail something capable of injury / damage / danger on the Croydon Tramlink System
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) intentionally attempted to

(A)_[place]_
(B)_[throw]_
(C)_[drop]_
(D)_[trail]_

a thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THE THING..), which

(E)_[was capable of injuring, damaging or endangering any person on, or any part of, the Croydon Tramlink System]_
(F)_[might have endangered the safe and efficient working of the Croydon Tramlink System]_
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 12(2), 30 and 26 of the Croydon Tramlink Byelaws made under section 46 of the Croydon Tramlink Act 1994.
english.pointstoprove:
